recommendations.labgrid: Disposable isolated pilot adapter to existing resource claims only. No second independent lock authority or live exporters.
recommendations.buildTools: Extend checksum-pinned Ansible user_tools or Windows maintained installer owners after active campaign; no cache-server restart during build.
recommendations.nvidiaToolkit: Separate GB10/driver/container compatibility gate; no generic tool rollout mutation.
recommendations.redis: Defer shared cache pending valid config, credential ownership, outage/miss/disk-pressure tests and actual measured benefit.
